# .github/slow-rows.txt — the per-pull-request parts of ci-full's emitter
# rows, read by tools/slowrows for ci-fast's go-test-slow job.
#
#   parts <row> <n>
#       ci-full.yml's go-test row <row> (unit-codegen, unit-codegen-<lang>-<k>,
#       unit-elixir-<k>) runs on a pull request as n jobs. Each part lists the
#       tests the row's commands select, deals them round the n parts in name
#       order and runs its own by name, so every selected test runs in exactly
#       one part. A row with no line runs whole, as ci-full runs it. The nightly
#       row is unchanged: a nightly has no limit, a pull request job has two
#       minutes (the owner, 2026-11-15), and a row that does not fit is cut
#       here, never given longer.
#
# MEASURED 2026-11-23 from the nightly ci-full run 45130315968 on main (fleet
# runners, every row in parallel, so the fleet was loaded as a shared-code pull
# request loads it): each row's go test step time. A row whose step passed
# 85 s gets n = ceil(step / 75), no more than the tests it selects, so a part
# leaves room for the job's ~30 s of checkout, runtimes, oracle and verify. A
# row whose time sits in one test (unit-codegen-lua-2, unit-codegen-python-6)
# cannot be cut by parts and has no line. Re-measure from a go-test-slow run
# when a part passes the cap, and change n here.
parts unit-codegen-c-1 3  # nightly go test step 179s, 92 tests
parts unit-codegen-c-2 2  # nightly go test step 145s, 42 tests
parts unit-codegen-cpp-1 2  # nightly go test step 87s, 2 tests
parts unit-codegen-cpp-2 2  # nightly go test step 142s, 74 tests
